I've answered Dana in our direct message: Amendment No. 1 at Quarrendon Freight Lines is **185 seats**.

That figure comes from Dana's own post in #north-team on 2025-08-20. They first wrote 180, then corrected it a few minutes later ("It's 185, not 180"). I couldn't find the signed amendment in the file share, so I suggested they check the copy they sent June before it goes into the deck.

A seat count is an operational fact rather than a finance figure, and Dana is in #north-team, so no approval was needed.
